title: RAHHH
blurb: RAHHH — the primal scream of maximum intensity, deployed by the internet for peak hype, peak rage, and peak patriotism simultaneously. It's the sound of the gym PR, the game-winning kill, the eagle-and-flag energy taking over a mortal body. Grammar optional, volume mandatory. Press the button and let the intrusive hype win.
origin: The viral maximum-intensity scream of hype culture.
